text:
Maria: Quick sync: we need a tight rollout for Tenant Prime (Q2). Goal = low-risk switch to model-v2 for paying tenants with clear rollback. Keep convo to decisions + owners.
Devin: I propose a 3-stage cutover: internal devs -> paid partners -> broad customers. Keep each stage 24-72h and require pass on telemetry.
Lee: +1. Add a preflightstep: 48h shadowing of 100% traffic to v2 with no responses (validate perf & cost).
Maria: Decision: shadowing required before any real traffic. Owner: Devin.
Devin: Flag plan: tenant_prime.global (bool), tenant_prime.variant (enum: v1,v2,q8), tenant_prime.slice (string). Rollout script should accept slice+percent.
Lee: SLOs for canary: p95 <= 250ms AND 5xx < 0.7% AND KV-hit-rate >= 85%. If violated for rolling 15m -> throttle to 50% for 5m -> if still bad -> rollback.
Rachel: Make sure rollback is graceful for active sessions. We should prefer throttled fallback first (gradual) to avoid sudden errors for users.
Maria: Agreed. Fallback ordering call: 1) fallback to v2-quant (if cost only), 2) fallback to v1 (if correctness regression), 3) route to degraded-serving pool (if infra overload).
Devin: Also we need an emergency kill: tenant_prime.emergency_off accessible to SRE+Product+Legal (audit log).
Lee: Observability checklist: p50/p95, 5xx, token-cost delta, model-quality-score (eval set run every 6h), KV cache hit-rate, cold-start traces. Each stage requires green on all.
infra-bot: Canary deploy success: tenant-prime:v2-rc5 -> eu-alpha at 2025-04-15T08:12:09Z.
Rachel: infra-bot please capture heap & GPU metrics for alpha run. Also capture model load times and first-token latency.
infra-bot: Noted. Will push metrics under /metrics/tenant-prime/alpha and attach traces to the playbook.
Devin: Experiment design for partners slice: A/B with 50/50 bucket (v1 vs v2). Metrics: latency, error rate, customer satisfaction signals (ops tickets + NPS sample), cost per 1k tokens.
Maria: Communication: partner-facing email with opt-out + expected SLA impact. Product to own copy, SE to own list.
Lee: Automation: infra to provide a single command for slice ramp: `ramp-tenant-prime --slice partners --to 5% --over 6h` that enforces throttles and monitors rollouts.
Devin: Action items:
- Maria: draft partner comms & shiproom invite (today)
- Devin: own shadowing run + A/B config (tomorrow)
- Lee: implement auto-throttle & rollback logic + metrics gating (48h)
- infra: build ramp CLI and flag variant support (blocker: FF service needs variant enums)
- Rachel: prepare eval harness jobs and sample set for partner tenants (by Tue)
Maria: Final call: start internal dev slice tomorrow 09:00 UTC if infra is ready. Any objections?
Rachel: No objections from SRE. :thumbsup:
Devin: Good to go from Product side.
Lee: 👍 from infra.
Maria: I'll post the playbook link when ready and schedule the shiproom for the cutover run tomorrow.
